description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The line representing “Base” is black with circular markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 32% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and increases to approximately 35% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The line representing “MEND” is brown with diamond markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 32% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and increases to approximately 47% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The line representing “FT” is blue with triangular markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 35% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and increases to approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The line representing “IKE” is red with triangular markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 32% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and decreases to approximately 40% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The line representing “MEMIT” is purple with circular markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 43% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and remains relatively constant at approximately 46% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The line representing “ROME” is green with square markers and is solid. It begins at approximately 43% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and increases to approximately 53% at a co-occurrence number of 10³.
